name: polier
description: AI software factory: runs a project through nine stations from idea to operation (web, iOS, Android, desktop, CLI, services), shows the live state in every prompt, turns every owner decision into a dialog and keeps builder agents to the plan with a write guard, recorded test evidence and reviews.

enforce.title: Write guard
enforce.description: deny blocks writes outside the task scope, ask turns a denial into a permission prompt, off disables the guard.

stop_check.title: Stop check
stop_check.description: Compare the git diff with the worker's scope before its turn ends.

max_stop_reminders.title: Stop reminders
max_stop_reminders.description: Reminders per turn before the stop check lets the turn end.

python.title: Python
python.description: Python 3.9+ interpreter for the Polier tools. Empty: python3 (python on Windows).

owner.title: Owner name
owner.description: Name written into records the owner decides in a Polier dialog.

context.title: Live context
context.description: Show the live <polier> block and the guide to the model inside a Polier project.
